content.title: The Resurrection of Jesus: History, Experience, Theology
content.author: Gerd Lüdemann, translated by John Bowden (London: SCM; Minneapolis: Fortress Press, 1994)
content.note: A sceptical critic's account: the appearance traditions are very early, the first appearances to Peter and to Paul were real experiences, but they were visions arising from grief, guilt and inner conflict, and Jesus' body decayed. The position's own case, used for the vision explanation. In copyright: described in our own words, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
